programme.title: VIVA PALMA - An Illes Balears Palma Futsal Story
programme.desc: In the heart of the Balearic Islands, AE Illes Balears Palma has redefined futsal. More than a team, it’s a culture built on ambition and unity. From humble beginnings to UEFA Futsal Champions League dominance, AE Illes Balears Palma’s story is one of resilience and excellence. This film dives into the soul of the club—its traditions, victories, and the people who made it a symbol of futsal supremacy.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.desc: Warrick efterforsker mordet på en ung pige i sit gamle kvarter.

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation: Scuba Doobie-Doo
programme.desc: Grissom, Sara og Warrick bliver sat til at undersøge en forladt, blodstænket lejlighed, alt imens Nick og Catherine skal efterforske en død dykker, der sidder fast i et træ.

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation: The Finger
programme.desc: Da en mand henvender sig til Catherine med grusomme beviser på, at hans elskerinde er blevet kidnappet, bliver hun uforvarende inddraget i sagen.

programme.title: Kvart i Bold: Indersiden: Gocholeishvili: Måtte klare sig selv som 13-årig
programme.desc: FCK-backen Gocholeishvili taler om sin opvækst og sin passion for at spille fodbold og sit fokus på altid at blive bedre

programme.title: Kvart i Bold: Indersiden: Pelle Peter: Den her klub er sat i verden for de europæiske oplevelser
programme.desc: Tag med når en af de bedste historiefortællere nemlig FCK fan Pelle Peter Jencel sætter ord på de magiske oplevelser vi sammen har haft i CL i efteråret

programme.title: Kvart i Bold: Indersiden: Viktor Fischer: “Jeg vil altid identificere mig med FCK”
programme.desc: En samtale med Viktor Fischer om hans personlige forhold til FC København både som spiller og menneske.

programme.title: Kvart i Bold: Indersiden: Neestrup: "Vi skal tænke worst case tidligere i vores defensiv”
programme.desc: Vi talte med cheftræneren og gjorde status på den flotte offensiv, på de mange mål der er lukket ind og om hvilke facetter i spillet, der skal forbedres for at vi når de mål vi har sat os

programme.title: Kvart i Bold: Indersiden
programme.desc: Orri Oskarsson blev solgt i slutningen af transfervinduet, og han kom så hurtigt afsted, at han ikke nåede at sige farvel til klubben og fansene. Det gør han her.

programme.title: Kvart i Bold: Indersiden: Oscar Højlund: “Jeg havde ikke været her uden mine brødre”
programme.desc: Få Oscars historie om et liv hvor fodbolden fylder alt. Om forholdet og det tætte bånd til Rasmus og Emil. Hør også hvilken spiller i truppen Oscar gerne ville være for en dag.

programme.title: Kvart i Bold: Indersiden: Robert Silva: "Fodbold er måden, jeg kan udtrykke mig på"

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Baseret på Richard Yates' bestseller følger denne fængslende og gribende historie om et lidenskabeligt, ungt par i forstads-Connecticut, som bestemmer sig for at risikere alt og følge deres drømme.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: To ensomme sjæle finder kærlighed og en forbindelse midt i storbyens kaos. En hjertevarm fortælling om kunst, skæve eksistenser og humor.

programme.title: Face The Music
programme.desc: Dramakomedie med Molly Ringwald og Patrick Dempsey. Et fraskilt par, der engang skrev sange sammen, bliver hyret til at producere en sang til en ny film. Kan de lægge deres problemer til side og skabe et mesterværk?

programme.title: The Con is On
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at slippe for at betale en gigantisk spillegæld, flygter Harriet og Peter til Hollywood. Planen er, at infiltrere et juvelrøveri som involverer Peters eks-kone.

programme.title: The Prince
programme.desc: Den pensionerede forbryderkonge og enlige far Paul, tvinges til at vende tilbage til Las Vegas og det kriminelle samfund, da hans datter kidnappes.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Girl I Married
programme.desc: An attorney and his wife have successful careers. They feel something is lacking in their marriage. Soon, they encounter younger versions of their mates.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Curious Case of Edgar Witherspoon
programme.desc: A woman tries to get her Uncle Edgar committed, believing that he is senile. The investigating doctor finds Edgar living in an apartment containing all kinds of junk.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programme.desc: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament
programme.desc: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Elegy
programme.desc: Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mirror Image
programme.desc: Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
programme.desc: Paranoia strikes the residents of Maple Street when they believe human-looking aliens have invaded the neighborhood.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of Difference
programme.desc: Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.

programme.title: True Colors
programme.desc: Mens Tim drømte om at arbejde for justitsministeriet, ønskede Peter at blive magtfuld politiker... for enhver pris.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Det er 2200-tallet. Føderationens U.S.S. Enterprise er på en træingsopgave, og admiral James T. Kirk (William Shatner) har forsonet sig med, at inspektionen kan blive den sidste rumrejse i hans karriere. Men Khan er tilbage.

programme.title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirks sejr over Khan og oprettelsen af Genesis-planeten er tomme sejre. Spock er død, og McCoy bliver på uforklarlig vis drevet til vanvid. Så giver et overraskende besøg af Sarek, Spocks far, en opsigtsvækkende åbenbaring..

programme.title: The Killer Meteors
programme.desc: Hua Wu Bin bliver kaldt The Killer Meteor på grund af hans unikke og hemmelige kampkunst, der har gjort ham til helt på hans hjemegn. Da en adelsmand bliver forgiftet af sin hustru, hyrer man Hua til at finde en kur og at besejre hende.

programme.title: Winners and Sinners
programme.desc: Fem venner bliver løsladt fra fængslet. De har bestemt sig for at leve hæderlige liv fremover, og sammen starter de et rengøringsfirma. Men samme dag løslades også en sjette fange og hans planer er at tjene penge på falskmøntneri.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Ghoul

programme.title: Fokus

programme.title: Spillerportrætter

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Kom helt tæt på trænerteamet i 29 intense og fokuserede dage, når Superliga-truppen gøres klar til forårspremieren. Oplev forberedelserne, beslutningerne og pulsen bag kulisserne, hvor hver detalje tæller frem mod den første kamp.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Martin Retov sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som først bød på en årrække som spiller og siden som træner.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller

programme.title: Spørg Løs!

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du med bag kulisserne til opgøret i Viborg og sejrene i Aarhus og Silkeborg. Oplev intensiteten, stemningen og de afgørende øjeblikke, når Brøndby jagter point på tre svære udebaner i Superligaen.

programme.desc: Kom ud på en køretur på Vestegnen med U/19-midtbanespiller i Masterclass Tahir Cevher. Hør om knægten fra Brøndby Strand og drømmen om at slå igennem i Brøndby og hvordan et nyt trænerteam har givet helt ny tro på tingene.

programme.title: BrøndbyLyd: Bag facaden
programme.desc: Mike Jensen kom op gennem ungdomsrækkerne som et stort talent og lærte hårdt arbejde. Han blev en del af seniortruppen i en svær tid for klubben, men har taget en masse med videre i sin karriere. Han er ægte Vestegnen.

programme.title: 3point.dk: Tæt på: Noah Nartey: Brøndbys plan for mig er rigtig god
programme.desc: Midtbanespilleren Noah Nartey banker for alvor på i Superliga-truppen. Måske venter gennembruddet lige om hjørnet. 3point.dk har fulgt Narteys udvikling fra første færd, da han kom til klubben som U/17-spiller. Kom helt tæt på den unge midtbanemand her.

programme.title: BrøndbyLyd: Bag facaden: Frederik Alves taler ud om grim skade
programme.desc: Frederik Alves har ikke været i aktion i foråret. Det skyldes en grim skade i akillessenen, og her taler forsvarsspilleren ud om skaden og det mentale aspekt i pludselig at sidde ude.

programme.title: Off-season
programme.desc: I episode 2 af Off-season møder vi Sean Klaiber, der deler sine erfaringer i Brøndby IF, og nye spiller Ousmane Sow, som fortæller om sin rejse fra Senegal og sine ambitioner i klubben.

programme.title: Blå/gul carpool: Heino Hansen
programme.desc: I denne uge kan du komme ud at køre med en af landets sjoveste mennesker. Og så holder han med Brøndby. Vi taler blandt andet om hvad det giver hans liv - på godt og ondt.

programme.title: UFC
programme.desc: Oplev de største kampe, de bedste atleter og de vildeste øjeblikke fra verdens førende MMA-organisation.

programme.title: Sportsdirektørerne
programme.desc: I andet afsnit af Sportsdirektørerne fortsætter fortællingerne fra direktionsgangen på Vestegnen, hvor der reflekteres over store beslutninger, særlige øjeblikke og den evige tilknytning til Brøndby IF.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' står den på EM-special og spillet 'Kend Din Holdkammerat'. Spillerne tester deres viden om hinanden og landsholdets store scene – med masser af grin, overraskelser og kamp om håneretten.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' møder du de nye forsvarsspillere Rasmus Lauritsen og Frederik Winther, hører Thomas Mikkelsen sætte ord på rollen som erfaren sidste skanse – og følger Joe Bells rejse og refleksioner i Brøndby-trøjen.

programme.title: Reservemålmændene
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Reservemålmændene' følger vi livet som målmand i skyggen af førstevalget. Hør om ankomsten til Brøndby IF, rollen som reserve og de største oplevelser – fortalt af dem, der altid er klar, men sjældent i rampelyset.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' gælder det EAFC 24 og det evige rivalopgør. Spillerne tester hinanden i 'Gæt en spiller' og dyster i en intens Derby Special, hvor både viden og håneret er på spil – og hvor konkurrencen når nye højder.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du Oscar Schwartau i 'Drengene fra Vestegnen'. Hør om rejsen fra ungdomsårene til gennembruddet i Superligaen – og hvad det betyder at repræsentere Brøndby IF som en af klubbens egne.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Ole Bjur sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' følger du Henrik Heggheims rejse fra Stavanger til Brøndby IF. Hør om overgangen til dansk fodbold, tilværelsen på Vestegnen og de oplevelser, der har formet ham som spiller og menneske i den gule trøje.

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Oplev et følelsesladet og nostalgisk tilbageblik på mesterskabet, ingen troede muligt. Hør historierne bag sæsonen, der kulminerede i Brøndby IF’s første triumf i 16 år – fortalt af dem, der selv var med til at skrive historien.

programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: The Cider House Rules
programme.desc: Den Oscar®-vindende publikumsfavorit om en mand, der søger efter et tilhørssted. Filmatiseret af bestsellerromanen, John Irvings stærke lektion om livet, kærlighed og hjemmet fik ros af kritikere og biografgæster over alt.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Too often, convicted felons learn new techniques and find new partners in prison. In 1982, a group of former inmates began a spree of kidnapping and robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Secret Service agenten Pete Garrison kommer påsporet af en forræder i Det hvide Hus, men bliver selvmistænkt og må bevise sin uskyld - inden det er forsent.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: Byen Stepford har en hemmelighed. Alle hustruerne er alt for perfekte og alle mændene er alt for lykkelige. Denne komiske thriller er en genindspilning af den spændende klassiker fra 1975. Velkommen til Stepford- den amerikanske drøm.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en meget succesfuld sælger, stresser over at få en stor handel. For at hjælpe hende skal hun slå sig sammen med Jonathan, der har travlt med at skabe en magisk jul til sin kæreste. Konflikten er givet, men noget andet begynder også at gry...

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: Three hapless guys are mistaken for Army Reservists and loaded onto an army plane headed for Iraq and then mistakenly ejected in a Humvee somewhere over Mexico.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den afdankede sherif i en lille by i Georgia, Ben Watts, bliver presset til hurtigt at løse en gidselsituation – og indser snart, at han er en brik i et større spil blandt byens skumle hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerede CIA-agent Robert kaster sig ud i en vovemodig redningsaktion af sin ærkefjendes enke, Sasha. Men snart konfronteres Robert med et velkendt ansigt, som han troede, han aldrig skulle se igen...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programme.desc: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis
programme.desc: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return
programme.desc: A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Thing About Machines
programme.desc: Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Carl Reiner (The Jerk) instruerede denne historie om John Candy som en familiefar, der tager en pause fra sund fornuft, når han lejer et sommerhus i Florida.

programme.title: Le Mans
programme.desc: Steve McQueen spiller en amerikansk racerkører, som deltager i 24 TIMERS LE MANS, i denne hurtige og voldsomme originale film. Filmen er optaget forskellige steder på Le Mans-banen og byder på imponerende bilulykke-stunts og hæsblæsende action.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Efter flere års krig forbereder føderationen og Klingon-imperiet en fredskonference, da et Klingon-skib næsten bliver ødelagt af et tilsyneladende angreb fra Enterprise. De to verdener ruster sig til deres endelige kamp.

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picards eneste håb for en fremtid hviler hos Nexus...og en legendarisk kaptajn fra fortiden.

programme.title: The Fearless Hyena
programme.desc: Unge Lung viser talent, men tager ikke sin træning alvorligt. Hans farfar og tillige shaolinmester, forsøger at lære ham både disciplin og kampsport, men han går mest op i det sidstnævnte. I stedet for at fokusere på træningen bruger han sin tid på barer.

programme.title: Armor of God 2: Operation Condor
programme.desc: Jackie Chans eventyrer er tilbage i en ny jagt på en glemt skat, skjult i ørkenen af nazisterne inden 2. Verdenskrig. Men Jackie og hans makker Ada er ikke de eneste, der leder efter skatten...

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 10
programme.desc: This episode includes: Down on the Farm, Update: The Promise, Trucker Death, Miracle Staircase and Follow the Shadow.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 11
programme.desc: This episode includes: Pix of the Dead, Johnny Lee Wilson (Pts. 1 & 2 + UD) and Totally Exhausted.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 12
programme.desc: This episode includes: Voodoo Victims, Skeleton Canyon, North Carolina Nightmare and England Heir & UD.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 13
programme.desc: This episode includes: Missing Medic & UD, Update: Serial Molester, Killer Casanova & UD and Vancouver Lights.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Lock Keepers Haunting at Lock 91
programme.desc: Sean heads to Manchester to investigate a lock keeper's cottage that was built in 1804. It appears that the spirits are still watching over the building and terrifying its customers.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Carnfield Hall
programme.desc: Carnfield Hall is a country house dating from the 15th and 16th Centuries. This private residence turn event hall is using its paranormal activity to draw in business. Are these spirits the old residents?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Long Lost Treasure at Jessops Old Mill and Auction House
programme.desc: The ghost dimension team visits Batley, West Yorkshire to investigate a location where it may not be the building that's haunted but the items that reside within.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Scars for Life

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ghost in the Machine
programme.desc: While investigating the apparent overdose suicide of Reverend Bill Guthrie's wife, detectives recover incriminating files from Bill's computer and learn of his infidelity.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: Tully er regissert av Jason Reitman og manuset skrevet av Diablo Cody, duoen som tidligere har laget Juno og Young Adults.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: ”Peace, Love & Misunderstanding” er et hjertevarmt portrett av en fargerik familie. Det som var ment bare å være en helgtur endrer seg raskt til å bli et sommereventyr fylt med romantikk, familiehemmeligheter, og det som trengs for å være lykkelig.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: En uvanlig spion utfører en hemmelig oppdrag under andre verdenskrig, der virkelighet og bedrag konfronteres i en intens kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Down Terrace
programme.desc: Etter å ha sonet fengsel for en mystisk forbrytelse, slipper Bill og Karl seg ut av fengselet og blir opptatt av å finne ut hvem som leverte dem til politiet. På toppen av det, er "familiebedriften" på steinene

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har fått vitnemålet sitt og en jobb på Callahan Auto Parts. Imidlertid begynner familiefirmaet å skrante, og nå legger Tommy i vei med farens høyre hånd, en selvgod regnskapsfører.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: En FBI-agent kler seg som en eldre dame for å beskytte en kvinne.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Them
programme.desc: Engang var Conor og Eleanor lykkelig gift. Nå føler de seg fremmed for hverandre, og i kjølevannet av en tragisk hendelse lengter de etter å finne tilbake til det liv og den kjærligheten de engang hadde.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie vender tilbake til den lille hjembyen sin da hun uventet blir verge for niesen og nevøen sin. Der møter hun Cooper, kjæresten fra high school.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: En kvinne flytter inn i et nabolag der en gruppe ektemenn har gjort konene sine til roboter som er designet for å ta vare på dem. Nyinnspilling av filmen fra 1975.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: Pumping Iron
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger og Lou Ferrigno møter hverandre i en intens konkurranse om Mr. Olympia-tittelen i denne kritikerroste filmen som gjorde Schwarzenegger berømt.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III
programme.desc: Det hele begynner med en at en magisk spire transporterer deres gode venn April gjennom tid og rom, helt til samuraienes Japan. Leonardo og gjengen drar med en gang etter henne, og må nå beseire den onde Lord Naringa for å redde April.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men
programme.desc: Etter å ha vært vitne til drapet på sin far, trener «Little Mute» i Shaolin-tempelet for å ta hevn, der han blir undervist av ulike lærere. Denne filmen vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Passasjeren
programme.desc: A sinister alien criminal hides his consciousness in the brain of someone aboard the station.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Animated Series
programme.desc: While exploring the planet Argo, Kirk and Spock are turned into water breathers.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Spock, Sulu and Uhura are captured by the Kzinti, who are trying to learn the secret of an ancient weapon.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Animated Series
programme.desc: While searching for a lost ship, Kirk, Spock and McCoy are captured and placed in a zoo by advanced, telepathic aliens.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Kirk leads a party to retrieve a religious relic that was stolen. However, he is faced with sabotage from within the group by someone who doesn't want the relic to be found, which will trigger an intergalactic jihad.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Spock is stricken by a disease fatal to Vulcans, the Enterprise is to meet a freighter with a load of drugs that provides the only cure, but Orion pirates attack the ship and Kirk must track down the Orions and the drug before it is too late.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer, Trip and T'Pol make first contact with the suspicious and militaristic Andorians while helping to reveal the secrets within the ancient Vulcan monastery of P'Jem, uncovering a major violation of the Andorian/Vulcan Peace Treaty

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel reiser til Istanbul for å undersøke dødsfallet til en av Sydneys venner, en professor som prøvde å bevise at Hercules eksisterte ved å finne Hippolytebeltet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himmelhvelvet
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer som tilsier ham til en planet med 'ild og is'.

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens han er fanget i en kamp mellom to Nietzschean-stolthetspunkter, fanger mannskapet en fiendtlig som hevder at stoltheten hans har et kart over slipstream.

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusjonen av majestet
programme.desc: En feil sving etter å ha gått ut av en slipstream sender Andromeda inn i Prolon-systemet. De redder en fluktpute fra en viss katastrofe, men stoltheten vil ha den tilbake.

programme.title: Andromeda: Twilight of the Idols
programme.desc: Mannskapet søker en tapt koloni av Nietzscheans og oppdager et annet mannskap som i det skjulte har hjulpet dem.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Cardassians
programme.desc: A young Cardassian, orphaned in the war and raised by Bajorans, causes turmoil on the station when his people attempt to reclaim him.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Melora
programme.desc: After failing in love with a woman whose species is unable to walk in "normal" gravity, Bashir develops a technology that could free her of her wheelchair forever.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Rules Of Acquisition
programme.desc: A Ferengi female who has defied the law and disguised herself as a male risks it all when she falls in love with Quark.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Necessary Evil
programme.desc: An attack on Quark's life brings Odo face to face with a five-year-old unsolved murder--for which Kira was a prime suspect.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Repentance
programme.desc: The issue of capital punishment divides the crew when Voyager agrees to transport condemned prisoners to their deaths.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Prophecy
programme.desc: A group of Klingons separated from the rest of their race believes B’Elanna’s unborn child is the Savior foretold in their sacred scrolls.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Void
programme.desc: Voyager is sucked into an inescapable subspace void which is inhabited only by other trapped vessels battling each other for survival.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Workforce, Part 1
programme.desc: The Voyager crew has been abducted and brainwashed to serve as workers in a severely short-handed industrial alien society.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Workforce, Part 2
programme.desc: To save Janeway and the rest of Voyager’s crew, Chakotay must convince her that her seemingly happy life as a worker on Quarra is not real.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: When the Federation promotes an officer exchange program, Commander Riker decides to accept an assignment aboard a Klingon war ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The Enterprise is ordered to proceed to an emergency Rendez-Vous to collect a special envoy who is traveling from Starbase 153 to meet them.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Riker returns from an away team mission wounded and infected with microbes from the planet below. He is soon in a coma in sick bay, the microbes having fused itself to his sciatic nerve and impeding his normal functions.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A Klingon commander boards the Enterprise in an officer exchange program initiated by Starfleet, much to the chagrin of the crew.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Scorpion, Part 2
programme.desc: The Voyager crew finds a solution to combat the invader of Borg space.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Gift
programme.desc: The crew must say goodbye to one member of their family just as they are adjusting to a new one.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Raven
programme.desc: Haunting visions lead Seven of Nine on a quest to rejoin the Collective.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking the Mold
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Fire
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign Here
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later, and witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 5
programme.desc: This episode includes: Nashville Hit, Padre Pio (Pts. 1 & 2), Update: Who Saved My Life?, Mystery Clerk and Sharon's Search.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 6
programme.desc: This episode includes: Chad, Family Man Fugitive, Agatha Christie (Pts. 1 & 2) and Fritz and the Soldiers.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 7
programme.desc: This episode includes: Bomb Throwing Fugitive, Paisley Hat, Mrs. Millionaire, Kyra's Crisis and Shack Fire.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 8
programme.desc: This episode includes: Vice Cop, Searching for Morgan, Sign from Heaven, Pizza Bandits, Lucie's Last Fare and Loving's Lost Love.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: The Ammo Store Explosion
programme.desc: Simonswood Supply Depot was one of the main ammunition depots in Lancashire, England during World War II. Located at Simonswood, it was used as an ammunition depot delivered by ROF Kirkby.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Ewloe Castle in North Wales
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean head to Ewloe Castle in North Wales, believed to be haunted by ghosts and spirits. What will they uncover as they delve deep into the castle ruins? and seek out its hauntings.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Final Session at Galleries of Justice
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travel back in time to The Galleries of Justice in Nottingham. This was a one stop shop for justice where criminals were held awaiting trial.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker in Nantwich. Something sinister and paranormal seems to be causing havoc inside of the building and tonight it unleashes powerful activity

programme.title: Under Arrest: I Hate Waterbeds
programme.desc: Police race to an attempted suicide, a domestic dispute turns violent and a vigilante assaults a car thief.

programme.title: Under Arrest: First Degree Black Belt
programme.desc: Police respond to a break-and-enter in progress, a suspect threatens to kill neighbors and a limo driver is assaulted.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Everybody Likes Beer
programme.desc: A burglary suspect jumps out a second-floor window, suspects lead police on a high-speed chase and a domestic dispute turns violent.

programme.title: Under Arrest: No Loving
programme.desc: Emergency response team arrests escaped fugitive, sports car crashes into lake and a suspect hides in a closet.

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: Police locate hidden drugs, a suspect brandishes a sword and a domestic dispute turns fishy.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Drunk Puppet
programme.desc: Brothers are involved in a bloody stabbing, police force entry to try and stop an assault and investigators are called to a suicide.

programme.title: Under Arrest: It's Alive!
programme.desc: Hostages are held in a grocery store, police attend a call of shots fired and drug dealers get into a motor vehicle accident.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Got a Warrant?
programme.desc: Police chase ends in water-filled ditch, a thief is caught in the act and police investigate a bloody assault.

programme.title: Under Arrest: It's a Big Joke
programme.desc: Police chase a stolen vehicle, a violent bar fight results in multiple arrests and a suspect threatens his neighbor.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Treacherous Treasure Hunt of Forrest Fenn
programme.desc: Join Ryan and Shane as they attempt to track down the mysterious hidden treasure of Forest Fenn.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Eerie Case of the Watcher
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane take a look at the case of the Watcher, a mysterious stalker who terrorized his neighborhood.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Unusual Australian Shark Arm Murder
programme.desc: Follow along as hosts Ryan and Shane go down under to examine a shark, a speedboat, and a mysterious severed arm.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Suspicious Case of the Reykjavik Confessions
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane discuss six people who confessed to murders that don't seem to have ever occurred.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Shocking Florida Machete Murder / The Puzzling Disappearance of Walter Collins
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane discuss the Florida machete murder and what became of the missing boy named Walter Collins.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: The Sentinel Spirit
programme.desc: Nick contacts the spirit of a sentinel that's been protecting a room where Civil War veterans gathered.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Nelly Crémel Case
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Drost Notthoff Case
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case
programme.desc: On the evening of August 30st 2013, in a small village of Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, 52 years old, reports his wife missing to the police. Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself?

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1999, 27-year-old Michelle Despinasse was shot dead in her Nanuet, NY home. Her answering machine captured her final moments, her voice pleading "Ken, stop", and became key evidence that convicted her ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?
programme.desc: On July 8, 1980, Andrew and Joyce Manchester returned from vacation to discover their 26-year-old daughter Anne had been missing for 10 days. She vanished without a trace and was never seen again.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 14-year-old vanishes on her walk home from school. Nine months later, she shows up alive and names her kidnapper. A solved true crime case that is harrowing, suspenseful, and an extraordinary story of a young girl's survival.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named
programme.desc: In November of 1973 female skeletal remains were found in a creek in Colorado. Her identity was restored after 51 years but authorities are still asking the public for help piecing together her story.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy

programme.title: Man On The Moon
programme.desc: Livet og karrieren til den legendariske komikeren Andy Kaufman.

programme.title: Tilfellet Henry
programme.desc: Henry er en vellykket advokat som må vinne for enhver pris, selv på familiens bekostning. Men et pistolskudd setter en stopper for Henrys karriere, lammer ham og fjerner alle minner om livet han hadde før.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Astronomen Zane oppdager intelligent utenomjordisk liv, men romvesenene holder på en dødelig hemmelighet og gjør hva som helst for å hindre Zane i å få vite den.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: I 2009 oppdaget NASA muligheten for fremmed liv innenfor vårt solsystem. En sonde ble skutt opp for å samle inn prøver fra en av Jupiters måner, Europa, men krasjet på tilbaketuren over Mellom-Amerika.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun trives som en smart, men ufokusert surfer, helt til han oppdager en roman av den anerkjente forfatteren Martin Skinner. Han blir inspirert, og forlater Orange County for å studere kreativ skriving ved Stanford University.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Animasjonsfilm basert på en historie avnorskættede Roald Dahl. Herr og fru Rev leveret idyllisk liv, men herr Rev begynner å kjennepå sine dyriske instinkter.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Tre menn gjenopplever sin sorgløse collegetid ved å drepe så mange hjerneceller de kan i denne forskrudde komedien. Mitch kommer hjem fra en mindre hyggelig forretningsreise og fersker sin kone Heidi i en trekant.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: 16-år gamle Megan Walsh er i trening for å bli en iskald internasjonal leiemorder, men i hemmelighet lengter hun etter å være en normal tenåring. Hun forfalsker derfor sin egen død.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: I etterkant av av en verdensomspennende atomkrig er Ann Burden (Margot Robbie) en overlevende. Ann frykter lenge at hun er det eneste gjenlevende mennesket på jorden, inntil hun oppdager noe helt forbløffende: et annen menneske.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: En kvinne flytter inn i et nabolag der en gruppe ektemenn har gjort konene sine til roboter som er designet for å ta vare på dem. Nyinnspilling av filmen fra 1975.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: En lidenskapelig kjærlighetshistorie mellom to personer med forskjellig bakgrunn og temperament, på tross av at de er en dårlig match klarer de ikke å gi slipp på hverandre.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: En høyt lovprist og prisbelønnet film, som blant annet fikk prisen for beste regi i Cannes i 1987. Damiel er en ensom engel som streifer omkring i Berlins krigsmerkede gater og trøster dødelige i nød.

programme.title: Dragon Lord
programme.desc: Jakten på kjærligheten og rampestrekene til Dragon og barndomsvennen Buller blir avbrytt når de hører at en gjeng begynner å smugle kinesiske nasjonal skatter utenlands. Denne filmen vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donatello, Rafael, Michelangelo og Leonardo er muterte, grønne ninja-skilpadder som elsker pizza og lever under New Yorks gateplan. Derifra tar de opp kampen mot den ondskapsfulle forbryteren Shredder og hans armé av svartkledde krigere.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
programme.desc: Skilpaddene tror at deres fiende Shredder er død etter at han falt i søppelknuseren i slutten av forrige film. Fotklanen har fått vite om deres gjemmested i kloakken og derfor bor de midlertidig hos journalisten April.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer attempts a little diplomacy with a very unwelcoming Vulcan Captain. Reed and Mayweather are in danger while drilling for samples on an uncharted massive comet.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Discovering their first alien civilization, Archer and the crew unfortunately also find a ship of invasive alien miners who are carelessly causing thousands of innocent deaths upon the planet.

programme.title: After Trek
programme.desc: Host Matt Mira and guests Shazad Latif and Ted Sullivan discuss "The Wolf Inside".

programme.title: After Trek
programme.desc: Host Matt Mira and guests Anthony Rapp and Jonathan Frakes (from Star Trek: The Next Generation) discuss "Vaulting Ambition" along with Jordon Nardino.

programme.title: After Trek
programme.desc: Host Matt Mira and guests Ted Sullivan, Rekha Sharma and Jason Isaacs discuss "What's Past Is Prologue".

programme.title: Mutant X: She's Come Undone
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet oppdager at lagkameraten deres Lexa er gjenstand for et skjult eksperiment som kontrollerer henne, og hunter etter ansvarlig lege.

programme.title: Mutant X: In Between
programme.desc: Når Jesses liv henger i sving, må Brennan koble seg til ham og lede ham gjennom minner de har delt for å redde livet hans.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Mutant X må stoppe en forsker fra å klone kvinner for bruk som slaver i sin ultra-eksklusive herreklubb.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Faux Fox
programme.desc: Når Nigel blir sjarmert av den briljante studenten Lorraine å vise henne kontorene sine (og kyss), slår en innbruddstyv Sidney ut, men hva ble ranet?

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Second Sight
programme.desc: Sisko falls in love for the first time since his wife's death, but the object of his affections may not be all that she seems.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Kira is torn when a displaced alien race arrives on Deep Space Nine and claims Bajor as its people's legendary homeland.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Rivals
programme.desc: Quark feels threatened when a charming swindler arrives on Deep Space Nine and opens a competing bar.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Alternate
programme.desc: Odo's mentor arrives on Deep Space Nine intent on resuming his search for Odo's true origin.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Armageddon Game
programme.desc: Bashir and O'Brien work to rid two alien races of deadly weapons, unaware that their hosts intend to sacrifice them as part of the peace process.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Human Error
programme.desc: Seven’s attempt to explore her human side distracts her from her duties and puts Voyager at risk.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Q2
programme.desc: Q’s unruly and omnipotent son wreaks interstellar havoc when he is left in Janeway’s care.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Author, Author
programme.desc: The Doctor publishes a holo-novel based on his Voyager experiences which scandalizes the crew.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Friendship One
programme.desc: Voyager recovers a long-lost space probe which has caused terrible radiation damage on a distant planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Natural Law
programme.desc: Seven and Chakotay stumble upon a race of primitive humanoids isolated from technological progress by an energy barrier.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: When the head of the Klingon high council passes on, Picard finds himself in the middle of the struggle for the now-vacant position. Meanwhile, Worf re-unites with a past love, only to find he now has a son.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A retired admiral boards the Enterprise in an effort to determine the actions aboard the ship surrounding an act of sabotage and possible treason.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Both Capt. Picard and Lt. Worf must decide where their priorities lie as the Klingon Empire descends into civil war.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Picard risks all-out war with the Romulans when he involves Starfleet in a Klingon civil war.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: One
programme.desc: With the fate of the crew in her hands, Seven must face her deepest fears alone.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Drone
programme.desc: The pupil becomes the teacher when a Borg drone is born on Voyager and Seven of Nine instructs him in the ways of humanity.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Infinite Regress
programme.desc: Seven experiences the Borg version of multiple personality disorder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Relativity
programme.desc: Voyager’s future depends on Seven’s success in preventing the past.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Tsunkatse
programme.desc: Killing for sport becomes Seven’s only means of survival when she is abducted into a ring of fisticuffs.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Private Thoughts
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 9
programme.desc: This episode includes: Priest Killer, Chicago Kidnap, Brinks, QI Gong, Update: Ready Teller Robbery and Such Is Life.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 10
programme.desc: This episode includes: Diaz Dog Days (Pts. 1 & 2), Murder by Arson, Baby Broker and Lost Sailor.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 11
programme.desc: This episode includes: Donald Eugene Webb, Internet Abduction, Child Prodigies, Fatal Obsession, Update: Surprise Sister and Oregon Heir.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 12
programme.desc: This episode includes: Repairman Death, Hero Molester, White Bird, Heads Up, Update: Mary and Martha and Nazi's Lazarus.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 13
programme.desc: This episode includes: Kay Hall, Mail Bombings, Trish's Miracle, Powers of Katie and Best Friends.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: The Evil Cook at The Shakespeare Pub
programme.desc: Sean explores The Shakespeare pub in Manchester and meets Flecky Bennett to investigate claims dating back hundreds of years, about an evil chef that is haunting the pub.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Thackray Medical Museum
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters investigate Thackray Medical Museum, believed to one of Leeds most haunted buildings. Workers claim to have witnessed constant paranormal activity in the museum and one claim is that two Victorian ghosts are trapped...

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Witches and Vampires Haunting St James Cemetery
programme.desc: St James Cemetery is set behind Liverpool Cathedral and is claimed to be the worlds most haunted, with the remains of over 58,000 people buried at the location and multiple claims of paranormal sightings.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Liverpool's Secret Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Bex and Sean delve deep into Woolton Hall, a derelict mansion in Liverpool. They appear to be forced out of the building by an unknown force and it takes its toll on one of the team members.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Under Arrest: Just One Kiss
programme.desc: A domestic dispute involves a knife-wielding spouse, a woman threatens to shoot and police dog searches for a thief.

programme.title: Under Arrest: A Big Bite
programme.desc: Police chase a suspicious vehicle, love gone bad results in a bloody altercation and a drug dealer is taken down at gunpoint.

programme.title: Under Arrest: How Many Beer?

programme.desc: 16 Augusti, Bockpremiär. Självklart beger vi oss till Blommeröd för att ta del av magiska jaktupplevelser och kulinariska mästerverk av Carl Dreyer.

programme.title: Vilterian: Burgare & Rygg
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt besöker Jompen Kim Nyström på Slottsholmen där det bjuds på vildsvinsburgare och en svårfångad förrätt.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Klappjakt
programme.desc: Lubbe och Jompen är i Östergötland på klappjakt. Vildsvin, Rådjur och slow motion står på menyn.

programme.title: Rett Vest
programme.desc: Georg Margrethe får et mentalt sammenbrudd etter konens bortgang. For å komme seg vekk fra elendigheten bestemmer de seg for å reise over fjellet til øya Ona, for å representere sin nylig avdøde kone i norgesmesterskapet i quilting.

programme.title: Santa Who?
programme.desc: I denne hjertevarmende julefortellingen faller den virkelige julenissen (Leslie Nielsen) ut av sleden sin og får hukommelsestap. Han møter snart en blasert TV-reporter som er hans eneste håp for å få hukommelsen tilbake i tide til å redde julen.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En iskald leiemorder får sitt liv snudd på hodet når han blir forelsket i sitt mål, en sjarmerende svindler med uventede planer.

programme.title: Legend
programme.desc: I en tidløs, mytisk skog er Jack utvalgt av skjebnen tilå redde den nydelige Prinsesse Lili og beseire dendemoniske Mørkets Fyrste. Hvis ikke kastes verden ut ievigvarende istid. Med Tom Cruise, Mia Sara og Tim Curry.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: DISASTER MOVIE fortsetter den komiske nedturen til din yndlingsgruppe med latterlig attraktive 20-åringer. En skjebnesvanger natt prøver de å komme seg i trygghet mens enhver kjent naturkatastrofe, knuser byen og deres vei.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones jakter intenst på kjærligheten - alltid på feil sted- helt til hun slår kloa idrømmemannen. Men en slu eks, en fjertende katt og eksentriske svigers truer...

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er lei av forholdet til kjæresten Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), en mega-fan av musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Når en akustisk demo av Tucks 25 år gamle plate plutselig dukker opp, fører dette til et møte med uventede konsekvenser.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Bryan Mills og hans kone er i Istanbul når de blir bortført. Mannen som holder dem som gissel viser seg å være far til en av de mennene som tidligere kidnappet Mills datter, og under frigjøringen av datteren ble han drept.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-eksperten Friar finner en bombe festet til stolen sin, og en hacker beordrer ham til å stjele digitale penger. Snart må Friar kjempe for å renvaske navnet sitt - uten å bli sprengt i fillebiter.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: I etterkant av av en verdensomspennende atomkrig er Ann Burden (Margot Robbie) en overlevende. Ann frykter lenge at hun er det eneste gjenlevende mennesket på jorden, inntil hun oppdager noe helt forbløffende: et annen menneske.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
programme.desc: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: En kvinne flytter inn i et nabolag der en gruppe ektemenn har gjort konene sine til roboter som er designet for å ta vare på dem. Nyinnspilling av filmen fra 1975.

programme.title: Sanctuary NO
programme.desc: Faren er mistenkt for mord og datteren Hella kan bli tatt hånd om og sendt i fosterhjem. De har bare hverandre og vegrer seg mot å skilles. De vil ikke gi opp friheten, pakker bilen og flykter inn i de dype skogene, hvor de finner et fristed ved en sjø.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: Da Jack Deebs satt i fengsel skapte han Cool World, en tegneserie om hespetreet Holli Would. Men blod er tynnere enn blekk når Holli tar menneskelig form i Las Vegas.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III
programme.desc: Det hele begynner med en at en magisk spire transporterer deres gode venn April gjennom tid og rom, helt til samuraienes Japan. Leonardo og gjengen drar med en gang etter henne, og må nå beseire den onde Lord Naringa for å redde April.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men
programme.desc: Etter å ha vært vitne til drapet på sin far, trener «Little Mute» i Shaolin-tempelet for å ta hevn, der han blir undervist av ulike lærere. Denne filmen vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: As the Enterprise provides transportation to two delegate parties who are constantly at odds with each other, the ship is invaded by something that jumps from computer terminal to crew members and back again.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After dropping off some colonists in a system nearby, The crew visits a world of beautiful, healthy & tanned human looking people who seem to have a peaceful & loving lifestyle.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After waiting for a response to their hails for three days, Picard finds that the Ferengi have discovered the "Stargazer," an old ship that he once commanded.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Kirk investigates an experimental facility for holding prisoners and finds a sinister scheme.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Sidney arver fra den beste relikviejegeren fra forrige generasjon en nøkkel og skynder seg med Nigel på jakt etter den ene skatten han aldri fant: Pandoras boks.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Warlord
programme.desc: Bekkastan, 1401 e.Kr.: krigerprinsesse Kahina beviser sin rett til å herske. 2002: Sydney og Nigel avdekker et hulemaleri som kan føre dem til Kahinas sal. Men hennes etterkommere forårsaker komplikasjoner.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dommens dag, Vredens dag
programme.desc: Mannskapet installerer en ny AI i et nytt Commonwealth-slagskip, og naturlig nok går ikke ting som de skal.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skygger kastet av en siste hilsen
programme.desc: Tyr overbeviser Nietzscheans at han er reinkarnasjonen til Drago Museveni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Svar gitt på spørsmål som aldri er stilt
programme.desc: En melding fra en samler sender Dylan på et oppdrag for å redde et gissel og finne restene av Commonwealth-flåten.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Whispers
programme.desc: O'Brien returns from a security mission to notice that the entire crew has seemingly turned against him.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Paradise
programme.desc: Sisko and O'Brien are stranded on a planet inhabited by humans who have rejected any form of technology.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Shadowplay
programme.desc: Odo and Dax try to solve the mystery of an alien planet whose inhabitants are disappearing without explanation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Playing God
programme.desc: While hosting her first Trill initiate, Dax discovers a tiny, developing universe, which threatens to destroy the station as it expands.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Profit And Loss
programme.desc: When Quark is reunited with the love of his life, a Cardassian who is now a fugitive, he is ready to sacrifice everything to win her back.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Homestead
programme.desc: Neelix is faced with the decision of a lifetime when Voyager locates a tribe of exiled Talaxians on a distant asteroid.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Renaissance Man
programme.desc: Janeway is held hostage by aliens who force the Doctor to help them steal Voyager’s warp core.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Endgame Part 1
programme.desc: Voyager’s quest to return home is aided by a visitor from the future – Admiral Kathryn Janeway.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Endgame Part 2
programme.desc: Janeway risks Voyager’s shortcut home in order to destroy the Borg and save millions of lives.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Worf learns some painful lessons about parenting when his son Alexander arrives to join his father on the Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Loyalty and ethics clash when a paralyzed Worf asks to help him commit suicide.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: An emergency beam out renders four crewmen down to childhood shortly before renegade Ferengi take over the Enterprise and offload the adults.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A Holodeck fantasy goes awry, sending Worf and his son into a Wild West showdown with a villain who's a dead ringer for Data.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Child's Play
programme.desc: The Voyager crew must rescue a young boy being used as a weapon of destruction against the Borg

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Unimatrix Zero, Part 1
programme.desc: Captain Janeway faces her biggest battle yet against the Borg—assimilation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Duett
programme.desc: Kira discovers that a Cardassian visiting the station could actually be a notorious war criminal.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Crossover
programme.desc: A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: True Lies
programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 14
programme.desc: This episode includes: Motorcycle Murder, Amber Swartz, Carlos' Con, Maine Petition, Message in a Bottle and Foster Son.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 15
programme.desc: This episode includes: R.F. Kennedy (Pts. 1 & 2), Gurdon Light, Tina's Search, Where's Baby Le-Zhan and Doggie Bowser MD.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 16
programme.desc: This episode includes: Who Killed Jeanine? (Pts. 1 & 2), Animal Saviors, Bus Stop Amnesia, Point Blank and Miriam's Memory.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries with Dennis Farina: Episode 17
programme.desc: This episode includes: Murder in Agawam, Murdered Mom, Missing Baby, Dropped Off Doe, Hotel Balcony Death, She Sold Babies and Genius Mystery.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death

programme.title: Parker
