programme.desc: Soban (small tray table) is a small table for placing dishes of food, playing an important role in Korean dining culture. Appreciate the traditional soban filled with the artisan spirit of the Sobanjang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Making Ink with Soot: Ink Master <36>
programme.desc: Ink, one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone), has been a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of the ink master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Swamp: Upo Wetlands <26>
programme.desc: How much time has passed in Upo Wetlands? It is a story of lives that have settled and live like masters in the place provided by the river.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Listening to the Mountain Temple: Haenam Daeheungsa <8>
programme.desc: Daeheungsa is located in Duryunsan Provincial Park, a famous mountain in Haenam, with traces of famous monks. Feel the serene scenery and sounds of the temple.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Light in the Darkness: Najeonjang <15>
programme.desc: Najeonjang refers to the craft of decorating lacquerware with mother-of-pearl designs or the craftsmen who practice this skill. Appreciate the beauty of traditional Najeonjang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.5 <13>
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.3 <3>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With King Sejo's Regret, Gwangneung <17>
programme.desc: The resting place of King Sejo and Queen Jeonghui, Gwangneung Forest in Namyangju covers an expansive area of 11 square kilometers, boasting ecological stability and species diversity. Enjoy a walk through its scenic forest paths.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Breathing Life into Hanji: Jiseung Master <33>
programme.desc: Paper can be crafted into various shapes of containers according to the maker’s intention. Welcome to the world of the Jiseung master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Magic of Making Paper that Lasts a Thousand Years: Making Hanji <55>
programme.desc: The process of making Hanji involves cutting, steaming, boiling, drying, peeling, re-boiling, pounding, mixing, scooping, and drying mulberry trees, undergoing 99 meticulous touches. Explore the dedicated process of 'Hanji making'.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Enduring the Summer Heat: Mat Weaving <57>
programme.desc: In the sweltering summer, hands weave coolness from strands of sedge. Each mat, boiled, dried, and tightly woven, holds the wisdom of tradition and the breath of community.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Dyeing in Royal Red: Red Dyeing Master <70>
programme.desc: The Great Red Color, once a royal hue, is drawn from blossoms through repeated extraction and careful dyeing. Each layer of color deepens through the artisan’s steady hands, preserving a legacy of elegance and tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Making Flower Shoes: The Art of Hand-Stitching <81>
programme.desc: A single pair of flower shoes holds hours of stitching and dedication. Threading the needle again and again, artisans create footwear that is both delicate and elegant. Sense the quiet patterns of tradition in every step.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Master’s Touch: Beating and Stitching Fabric <85>
programme.desc: From selecting fabric to quiet stitching, every step in traditional quilting reflects careful devotion. Through rhythmic beating and fine needlework, practical craft meets gentle beauty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Coloring the Crimson: Dyeing in Royal Red <86>
programme.desc: Royal red, extracted from safflower petals, was once reserved for royalty. The repeated soaking and coloring bring out its deep hue. Witness how this noble color is born through layers of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Hat Full of Jeju: Cocculus Hat <71>
programme.desc: Woven from Jeju’s native vines, the cocculus hat reflects the islanders’ harmony with nature. Once used to shield from sun and rain, it carries the quiet wisdom of a life rooted in the land.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Night, Sound of Light: Muju Anseong Nakhwa Play <16>
programme.desc: Muju Anseong Nakhwa Play is named because the sparks falling along the line resemble flowers and is designated as an intangible cultural heritage traditional play.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Striking the Jing: Brassware Master <68>
programme.desc: With thousands of hammer strikes, the jing emerges—not just as an instrument, but as a deep, resonant voice of tradition. Made from molten copper and tin, it is shaped and tuned through breath and rhythm passed down for generations.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating Wind: Seocheon Fan Master <27>
programme.desc: The peacock fan is a traditional fan cherished for its luxurious and elegant appearance. Let’s follow the process of artisan making the fan, from harvesting the bamboo to preparing the materials and completing the fan.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Quilting with Devotion: Quilting Master <69>
programme.desc: Hand-stitched layer by layer, traditional nubi quilting is a labor of patience, care, and artistry. The countless straight, repeated stitches not only provide warmth and durability but also reveal a quiet beauty passed down through generations.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Unwavering Focus: The Horsehair Headband Making Master <91>
programme.desc: Made by meticulously weaving fine strands of horsehair, the manggeon was a refined headpiece worn by men in the Joseon era. Each knot reflects the artisan’s steady hand and quiet discipline. Experience the silent intensity behind this delicate craft.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Joseon Ceramics: Porcelain Master <23>
programme.desc: The Baeksan family is a traditional prestigious family that has continued Korean ceramics for over 300 years since the era of King Yeongjo of Joseon Dynasty, greatly supported by the efforts of son Kim Kyung-sik, and grandson Kim Ji-Hoon.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Masterpieces Created by Time: Ink (Meok) <51>
programme.desc: Ink (Meok) has been one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone) and a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of ink, masterpieces created by time(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Griddle of Joseon: Metal Casting Master <73>
programme.desc: From molten metal to cast iron cookware, traditional casting techniques shaped the daily tools of the Joseon era. The griddle, born from fire and precision, reflects the balance of practicality and artistry.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Art of Steel: Ornamental Knife Making Master <67>
programme.desc: Small in size, yet rich in meaning—ornamental knives once symbolized both elegance and status. Through intricate forging and decorative detail, these steel blades carry the strength and refinement of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Full of Sensations: Royal Confectionery Tea Table <2>
programme.desc: Let’s make a tea table full of sensations! Experience various delicacies filled with dedication and handmade taste, such as mugwort rice cake balls (Ssukguridan) and twisted flour dough flower rice cakes.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Magic of Making Paper that Lasts a Thousand Years: Making Hanji <55>
programme.desc: The process of making Hanji involves cutting, steaming, boiling, drying, peeling, re-boiling, pounding, mixing, scooping, and drying mulberry trees, undergoing 99 meticulous touches. Explore the dedicated process of 'Hanji making'.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Golden Patterns. Gold Leaf Master <21>
programme.desc: The technique of gold leaf, which enhances the beauty and elegance of Korean clothing, is a traditional art where thin gold leaves are applied to fabric to add beauty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.4 <4>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Life of the Mudskipper, Shinan Mudflats <6>
programme.desc: Constituting 85% of Korea's UNESCO-designated tidal flats, Shinan Mudflats are the largest and most unique, formed among numerous islands. Explore the charming life of the mudskipper in this ecologically valuable area.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Last Movie Star
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as an aging screen icon who gets lured into accepting an award at a rinky-dink film festival in Nashville, launching him on both a hilarious fish-out-of-water adventure and an unexpectedly poignant journey into his past.

programme.title: 20th Century Women
programme.desc: In 1979 Santa Barbara, Calif., Dorothea Fields is a determined single mother in her mid-50s who is raising her adolescent son, Jamie, at a moment brimming with cultural change and rebellion. Dorothea enlists the help of two younger women -- Abbie, a free-spirited punk artist living as a boarder in the Fields' home and Julie, a savvy and provocative teenage neighbor -- to help with Jamie's upbringing.

programme.title: When You Finish Saving the World
programme.desc: Evelyn (Julianne Moore) tries to parent an unassuming teenager at her shelter while her oblivious son Ziggy (Finn Wolfhard) fumbles through his pursuit of a brilliant young woman at school.

programme.title: Dream Scenario
programme.desc: Hapless family man Paul Matthews (Nicolas Cage) finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams. But when his nighttime appearances take a nightmarish turn, Paul is forced to navigate the consequences of his newfound stardom.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

programme.title: The Skeleton Twins
programme.desc: Following many years of estrangement, twins Milo (Bill Hader) and Maggie (Kristen Wiig) have an unexpected reunion after a set of near-tragedies. The situation forces them to confront how their lives became so broken. For Maggie, it means examining why she's so unhappy in a marriage to a loving husband. For Milo, it means meeting with his first love to see if their romance can reignite. Eventually, they learn that living truthfully and accepting each other is the only way to move forward.

programme.title: C'mon C'mon
programme.desc: Johnny and his young nephew forge a tenuous but transformational relationship when they are unexpectedly thrown together in this delicate and deeply moving story about the connections between adults and children, the past and the future.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

When the investigation uncovers a sordid story of love affairs and stolen money, authorities think they're closing in on the killer. But a lack of evidence causes the case to go stone cold for 14 years.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Newlyweds Katie and JD have ever-escalating tension with JD's ex-wife Robin. When Robin is found shot to death, in an apparent robbery gone wrong, police arrest the killer. Or...do they? There is a demon in disguise and only a last-minute discovery will lead detectives to the truth.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Keith Gentry is shot in his sleep in the middle of the night, and left to be found by his wife, Darlene. The Texas Rangers are then brought in to investigate the murder, wading through discrepancies and lies as they narrow in on their suspect.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: When a man's family and co-workers lose touch with him and can't find any trace of him for days, the police are sent to his apartment to investigate and see what they can figure it out. But what they find is far worse than any of them expected.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Random shootings, rapes, and robberies leave almost all of the residents of Phoenix, Arizona scared. On top of that, authorities are seemingly powerless against serial killers that are waging a war of terror on the streets of this Arizona city.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: On an unusually warm September morning beloved yoga instructor Michael Dojaquez is found shot dead on his front porch. With a rash of violent home burglaries reported in his Tucson neighborhood in recent weeks, detectives line up the usual suspects only to find themselves spinning down the rabbit hole of a bizarre 'love triangle' homicide investigation with no murder weapon and the perfect alibi.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Marc Despain is discovered by his wife Michelle, shot dead in his kitchen with the house made to look like it had been burglarized. But the evidence soon leads police to members of Marc's own inner circle, where long-standing blood feuds may have reached the boiling point and led to Marc's murder.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Tireless nurse Bonnie Woodward would never simply disappear and leave her family behind - that's not the type of person she was. After she is murdered, investigators believe they have her killer but it takes 10 years to break the case wide open.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Trenton Mallory and fiance Amber Smith of Levering, Michigan have had their ups and downs in recent years. Things finally seem to be on the upswing when 'Trading Trent' as he is known because of his hobby of buying and selling guns is found shot in his bed while still asleep.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Petoskey, Michigan, blue-collar worker Lyle Kopenkoskey is a well-liked man who lives a simple life with his wife of nearly 40 years, Carol. But everything changes one cold October night when Lyle is found dead only a mile from his home. With minimal evidence and a lack of suspects, investigators find themselves racing against the clock to prevent the case from going cold.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Vince is a seasoned New Orleans sportscaster, and his marriage to the much younger Liz looks like a second chance for them both. When Liz is shot point blank in the face, police pursue a notorious vagrant who fits the witness's description. But the more police dig into this murder, the game appears to be bigamy, and all the rules are off the table.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Beloved congregation member Rhonda Smith seems like the last person who'd be found shot to death at church. But as rumors of affairs begin to swirl, the handsome new pastor and a threatening stranger are just the starting point of an investigation that leads police into the mouth of madness.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: In Pensacola, Florida, ex-cop and private investigator Taylor Wright is moving into a new home with the love of her love when she inexplicably disappears without a trace. At first it appears as if she may have simply run away.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: There have only been two reported murders among the Amish in America in more than 250 years. But peace-loving Barbara Weaver, a pillar of the Amish community, is shot to death in her bed. Investigators discover that the coldest of executioners can hide shoulder to shoulder among the godly.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: A family man is found shot to death and dumped in a rural orchard; it looks like a carjacking. Police meticulously piece together surveillance video that seems to show a mystery woman park his car and walk away. Police hang on doggedly to the trail of an elusive killer, who leads them on a journey that is almost too astonishing to believe.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Just weeks before Christmas, in the sleepy town of Early, Iowa, two men break into the home of Tracey Richter and attack her while her children hide in a nearby bedroom. Tracey shoots and kills one of them in the process, claiming self-defense. But as investigators look closer at the case, something about her story just doesn't add up.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Police in Chicago, Illinois connect a series of local murders that ends up putting them on the hunt for a serial killer. Little do they know, their target has been busy on the other side of the country, hunting women in the California desert.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: An Olympic shot putt athlete is found dead in his own yard, shot multiple times. Police determine that this murder was no random act of violence, and the evidence soon uncovers a series of dark family secrets that threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Body builder Doug and his deputy sheriff girlfriend Tracy bond over their love of weightlifting, but all they do lately is quarrel. When Doug's body is discovered encased in concrete, all fingers point to Tracy. But Tracy insists that it's physically impossible and she's being framed by the same sheriff's department she once worked for.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: When a Texas oil tycoon's badly decomposing body is found in his beauty queen girlfriend's mansion, police fear the worst and issue a nationwide alert to find her. But when they learn their relationship has recently been rocky, no one is sure whether they're hunting for a victim...or a killer.

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: Jeremy Simko is a firearms enthusiast whose property is outfitted with every conceivable security device, from motion detectors, to cameras, to savage, barking dogs. So when his wife Julene finds him shot to death in their bed one night, the question for police is, how could an intruder possibly have gained access to the Simko bedroom?

programme.title: Fatal Crimes
programme.desc: In Newport Beach, California, millionaire medical innovator Bill McLaughlin is living a luxurious life inside the gated community of Balboa Coves - until he is shot six times in his own kitchen. When the investigation uncovers a sordid story of love affairs and stolen money, authorities think they're closing in on the killer. But a lack of evidence causes the case to go stone cold for 14 years.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: 444 Days: The Iran Hostage Crisis
programme.desc: It was a 444 days ordeal for the American diplomats taken hostage in Tehran. 444 days of humiliation for the most powerful nation in the world, the United States. In these 444 days, Iranian Islamists imposed their will on their country and the world. Rediscover the events of November 4, 1979 to January 20, 1981.

programme.title: The Auschwitz Museum
programme.desc: Here's the Auschwitz-Birkenau museum, as it appears to us: vestiges, ruins, traces. Some barbed wires, some barracks, some birches. A museum without any works of art, a cemetery without any graves, a Unesco listed site, yet without any trace of heritage. Thousands of visitors are coming here every day in numbers and from all around the world, without really knowing what they're looking for.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.desc: As a military leader, Louis XV, was popular and successful, but he led France into the disastrous Seven Year War with Britain. As his Empire dwindled, Louis amused himself with scandalous love affairs, his own private brothel and bedded five sisters from the same aristocratic family. This is a florid and hugely enjoyable saga of sex, war, torture, gluttony, and some truly astonishing wigs.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Iliad
programme.desc: Thetis asks Hephaestus, the god of blacksmiths to forge new armour and weapons for her son Achilles. At dawn, she hands them to him, knowing that they will lead to his death.

programme.title: Elizabeth I: End of the Tudor Dynasty
programme.desc: With the end of Edward VI, Elizabeth I's struggles as Queen. Many questions arise as we dive deep into various aspects of her reign. Was it actually a misuse of mercury that spelled Edward's death? Was the Virgin Queen really a virgin? What was the cause of Mary Tudor's phantom pregnancies? Queen Elizabeth I put up a strong appearance that shadowed her deepest insecurities.

programme.title: Operation Valkyrie: The Plot to Assassinate Hitler
programme.desc: On July 20th, 1944 a group of German conspirators lead by Claus von Stauffenberg attempted to assassinate Adolf Hitler himself. The plan was to remove the Nazi Party from power, and then make peace with the Allied Forces to end the bloodshed and show the world that not all Germans were like Hitler. However, the plot failed and lead to nearly 5,000 executions.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: From the air, Britain's rural landscape seems wild-fields, heathlands, forests. In truth, it was shaped by centuries of reclamation, deforestation, and farming. Later, aristocrats drew inspiration from nature to create the famed English garden, distinct from continental designs.

programme.title: Elizabeth I
programme.desc: Amy Robsart was the wife of Robert Dudley, one of England's leading noblemen. He was believed to be the lover of Queen Elizabeth I. Rumours had circulated that the Queen wanted Amy dead. So when Amy was found at the bottom of a staircase in her Oxfordshire home, few believed it to be an accident, and many openly talked of how the Queen and Dudley had conspired to murder Amy.

programme.title: Life in the Time of
programme.desc: Take a dive into ancient Rome, where gladiatorial fights took place regularly. As of the 3rd century BC, these were highlights in the life of the city. In the amphitheatres, the crowd thronged to see professional fighters, free or slaves, sometimes to the death. Schools dedicated to learning the art of combat were throughout the Empire, those of Aquileia and Capua being among the most famous.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: A year has passed. It is time for Odysseus and his men to leave the witch Circe's island and return to Ithaca. To do so, they must first go to meet the prophet Tiresias in the Underworld. Only he can tell them what to do to appease Poseidon's wrath.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: In the 19th century, coal powered Britain's rise as the world's industrial leader. Mining reshaped South Wales, fueling railways, factories, and cities like Manchester and Birmingham. Workers flocked to urban neighborhoods of back-to-back houses, forging a new social fabric. This transformation, both economic and physical, marked an era when landscapes and lives were remade at unprecedented speed.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Iliad
programme.desc: Ten years have passed since the Greek forces arrived in Troy, but King Priam's city has still not fallen. The king's eldest son, Hector, reproaches his brother Paris for causing this war with no end.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: In 711, Arab and Berber troops crossed Gibraltar, defeating the Visigoths at Guadalete and spreading rapidly across Iberia. Within five years, Al-Andalus stretched from south to Galicia. For nearly eight centuries, Muslim rule left a lasting mark-enriching Spanish culture, transforming cities, and building mosques, palaces, and landmarks that remain central to Spain's heritage today.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: For years, Egyptologists sought Cleopatra's tomb, a treasure yet undiscovered. But a recent find offers hope-a mummified hand, claimed to be hers, surfaced in an American collector's possession. International experts join forces, tracing the relic's journey from excavation sites to DNA labs. Through exclusive investigation, the film aims to unveil the 2,000-year-old mystery of Cleopatra.

programme.title: Besieged Fortresses - Legendary Battles
programme.desc: Despite an overwhelming force of 180,000 men, the Ottomans, led by Soliman are unable to shake the fortifications of Rhodes. They then organize a massive maritime blockade and an underground mining mission. Will it be enough to infiltrate the island and defeat the Knights Hospitaller?

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries. While many historians believe it is located near a temple to Isis, East of ancient Alexandria, new discoveries indicate that it might be near Taposiris Magna. Through field excavations, 3D modeling and reenactments, this documentary series will retrace the life of Cleopatra.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: Food not only mirrors society, it shapes landscapes, coloring fields and vineyards through the centuries. From wheat in France to rye in Germany, from wine to beer, clichés blur when history is traced. Flying above both lands, we uncover shifting 'food borders' born of shared heritage, revealing how culture and geography intertwined to craft their culinary identities.

programme.title: Ancient Megacities
programme.desc: Persepolis, once envisioned as the Middle East's Garden of Eden, epitomizes opulence and empire. Through centuries and archaeological finds, its mysteries unravel. Explore how this marvel emerged, its true role unveiled by recent discoveries. Witness the tragic destruction of centuries of architectural brilliance in mere hours. Persepolis unveils its astounding secrets in this captivating journey.

programme.title: Castles & Palaces of Europe
programme.desc: From the 16th to the 18th centuries, the Dukes of Savoy surrounded Turin with a 'crown' of residencies. The Palazzo Reale, today houses ceremonial swords and weapons, while the shroud of Turin is kept in the adjoining cathedral of Saint John the Baptist. The Reggia di Venaria, which was formerly a barracks during Bonaparte's conquest of Italy, has been renovated, narrowly escaping ruin.

programme.title: Napoleon Bonaparte: The Russian Campaign
programme.desc: Part 2 details the hardships and deprivations suffered by Napoleon's Grande Armee as they await the surrender of the Tsar, which never comes. And with problems in France and his popularity waning, Napoleon begins the long, death-filled retreat from Russia with his exhausted, starving troops.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: Ten years after the sack of Troy by the Greek army, Zeus is alone on Olympus, left alone in his palace by the other gods. His daughter Athena is the only one remaining at his side. She tries to convince her father to help Odysseus, the last Greek fighter who has not yet returned home to Ithaca.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: In this myth, many versions of which have been passed down through the ages, Psyche is the Beauty. Concerned that his daughter did not have a suitor, Psyche's father consulted Pythia, who announced grave news: Psyche's father must leave her on a hilltop, from where a monster would come take her away.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Springfield, Illinois, the Lake Club was once a lively dance hall where fortunes were won and lost. In 1974, Bill and Tom transform it into a rock club and soon uncover eerie secrets. Phantom music and chilling cold spots make them believe they are not alone. Others share their fears, and a young woman receives a ghostly warning: one of the owners is about to die.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. He and his sister are attacked at night-pinned to their beds by unseen forces. Billy senses an evil presence destroying his family. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Sphinx
programme.desc: Across the silvery Nile from Cairo in Egypt, in the shadow of the great pyramids, is one of the true wonders of the world. For nearly five thousand years its existence has been shrouded in mystery, controversy and uncertainty. How long has it been there? Who built it and when? Why was it built? Whose face is on it? Are there secret chambers underneath?

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: A two-month immersion in one of the greatest archeological missions to crack the secret teXts of Saqqara.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: Built for pharaoh Khufu over 4,500 years ago, the Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the Seven Wonders still standing today - and is by far the most famous of all pyramids! Yet, this jewel still holds many secrets. Thanks to an exceptional behind-the-scenes access, we'll try to unravel remaining mysteries. Secret chambers have much to reveal about the origins of this stone giant!

programme.title: Decoding da Vinci
programme.desc: 500 years after his death, Leonardo da Vinci's painting is still just as fascinating. And yet, there are only 16 surviving canvasses attributed to him, some of which are unfinished. Through analysis of infrared reflectography, a technique that reveals the drawing beneath the layer of paint, the film underlines the prowess of da Vinci's work and captures its meaning and emotion.

programme.title: The Romanovs
programme.desc: The ascension of Catherine's son Paul following her death in 1796. Reigning only for five short years, Paul was then succeeded by his own son, Alexander, who reigned during the tumultuous period of the Napoleonic Wars.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Unknown Images
programme.desc: For the first three years of the war, the U.S. Infantry had two very different missions to win 'Hearts and Minds' and to 'Search & Destroy'. Join U.S. combat cameramen as they are choppered in alongside the troops to capture the fighting on assault operations including Starlight, Cedar Falls and Masher.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: Odysseus and his companions are trapped in the Cyclops' cave. But he is a man with a plan. He carves out a stake and, after having drunk Polyphemus under the table, drives it into his one eye.

programme.title: We Were There
programme.desc: We Were There captures the voices of America's greatest generation, as they share their stories of duty, service, and responsibility during World War II. While the tumultuous global events of the early 1940's provide the backdrop for this film, it is the men and women recalling their personal stories who take center stage.

programme.title: Where is Hitler? A Hot Trail During the Cold War
programme.desc: Did the Fuhrer escape with a submarine to Argentina, was he living in Washington D.C. or is there proof that he committed suicide? FBI, British intelligence and German authorities followed every rumour, hint and trace. Previously undisclosed files, interrogation tapes, rare footage and photographs have been compiled in an attempt to ascertain the circumstances surrounding Adolf Hitler's death.

programme.title: Nazi Creatures
programme.desc: Hitler, Goring, Himmler: the three architects of the Final Solution. They, like many other high ranking Nazis, shared a fascination with the animal world. In the last days of the Nazi regime, Hitler risked his life every day, leaving the safety of the bunker to walk his beloved dog, Blondi. But the Nazis' interest went beyond love of their pets or the animal welfare laws they introduced.

programme.title: Angkor Rediscovered
programme.desc: Using the most sophisticated technologies in conjunction with research focusing on statues, casts, and documents handed down by Louis Delaporte. He was one of the first explorers of Angkor in the 19th century.

programme.title: Napoleon Bonaparte: The Egyptian Campaign
programme.desc: Exploring Egypt proved more challenging than anticipated. Between the cultural shock, divergence of interests between the military and scientific communities, the epic combat with Mamelukes and Ottomans, popular uprisings, and outbreaks of the plague, this was an expedition to remember.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Taking revenge against Prometheus, Zeus created the first woman - the beautiful Pandora. He gave her a manipulative and deceptive character, and subjected Prometheus to terrible torture. But although Zeus and Prometheus both shared a shrewd and cunning nature, they clashed fiercely. Prometheus wanted to be of help to mankind, and managed to convince Zeus to give them fire.

programme.title: The Destiny of Rome
programme.desc: Ten years later, the supreme strategist Octavian waged the naval battle of Actium against his former ally, who now had the backing of Cleopatra. Octavian put an end to Antony and Cleopatra's military ambitions and became the first Roman emperor under the name of Augustus. Witness the last moments of the Roman Republic, marked by this terrible duel between two men hungry for glory.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: In Saqqara, Zahi Hawass and his team uncover a trove of sarcophagi from the New Kingdom and Late Period. With over forty shafts dug, they anticipate rich discoveries. As they scan and possibly open the coffins, unexpected secrets emerge, revealing glimpses into Ancient Egypt's past. Forensic techniques transport them back over three millennia, breathing life into long-buried individuals.

programme.title: The Viking Myths
programme.desc: Meanwhile, Kvasir (the being born out of peace) goes out into the world and answers all questions with ease. So much so that the two dwarf brothers capture Kvasir, murder him, drain his blood and mix it with mead: thus creating the Mead of Poetry, a metaphor for poetic inspiration.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: Before Spain was Spain, it was Hispania. Roman troops landed in Ampurias in 218 BC, bringing centuries of stability that reshaped the Iberian Peninsula. Roads, aqueducts, bridges, and great cities transformed the landscape, many still visible today. Hispania became a jewel of Rome, a vital economic hub, and a bastion of empire that produced influential leaders and governors.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Once man moved from hunter-gatherer to crop grower and farmer, he needed somewhere permanent to live, and to protect his property. From earliest civilization, forts, barricades and battlements were an intrinsic part of the world. Some of the oldest defensive structures still exist, and date back to the days of Assyria, Egypt and Greece.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: Odysseus has been living out peaceful days with Calypso for 7 years. But waves of nostalgia wash over him, and the memories of his wife, his son and his island never cease to torment him. Hermes, sent by Zeus, under pressure from Athena, comes to ask Calypso to let the king of Ithaca leave.

programme.title: Besieged Fortresses - Legendary Battles
programme.desc: Constantinople, the jewel of the Byzantine Empire, has stood for a thousand years. Now, Sultan Mehmed II leads an army, and a stunning new superweapon, against this last remnant of Christianity in the East. But Emperor Constantin XI knows his fortress and will fight to the death to keep it.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: America is full of forgotten cemeteries, some buried beneath new homes. Bobby Wilcott buys a historic manor in Indiana, hoping renovations will strengthen his marriage. But strange occurrences strain their bond-doors won't stay shut, lights flicker, and unease grows. Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Springfield, Illinois, the Lake Club was once a lively dance hall where fortunes were won and lost. In 1974, Bill and Tom transform it into a rock club and soon uncover eerie secrets. Phantom music and chilling cold spots make them believe they are not alone. Others share their fears, and a young woman receives a ghostly warning: one of the owners is about to die.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators risk their own safety to protect others. Mary Vogel, a spiritual counselor, faces a force that shakes her faith. Nightmares consume her, unseen entities attack, and even church feels sinister. A voice whispers, 'Your God can't help you now.' Her mentor, John Zaffis, realizes the truth-Mary is possessed, and only an exorcism can save her soul.
